A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same GRAM-DTI research work, with readable text, equations, figures, tables and Appendices A–G. Both have 22 pages; pages 2–22 have identical extracted text and rendered appearance.

before.justification: v1 reports original GRAM-DTI prediction, zero-shot retrieval and ablation results in Section 4, with additional performance statistics and embedding analyses in Appendices D–F.

after.justification: v2 retains the original prediction, retrieval, ablation and embedding-analysis results, including the cross-validation statistics in Appendix E.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Algorithms 1–3 are identical. The encoders, projectors, volume and bimodal losses, adaptive modality dropout, IC50 supervision and downstream prediction procedure are unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same TRIDENT/BindingDB pretraining data and Yamanishi 08, Hetionet, Activation and Inhibition benchmarks. DTI, mechanism-of-action prediction, bidirectional retrieval and warm/cold-start coverage are unchanged.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains the same comparator participation: CPL-GNN, MPNN-CNN, KGE-NFM and DTIAM for DTI, TransformerCPI on Yamanishi 08, and AI-DTI/DTIAM for mechanism-of-action prediction. Table 2 retains DTIAM for retrieval.

E3.justification: The positive-to-negative sampling ratio, warm/drug-cold/target-cold splits, 10-fold DTI and 5-fold mechanism-of-action cross-validation, metrics, training configurations and retrieval procedures are identical in Section 4 and Appendices C and E.

E4.justification: Both retain the same component-removal ablations on Activation and Yamanishi 08 (Figures 2 and 4), and the same embedding-evolution analyses across epochs and sample sizes (Figure 3 and Appendix F).

E5.justification: Table 6 reports the same means and standard deviations across cross-validation folds in both versions. Fold counts and all other statistical reporting remain unchanged.

E6.justification: All reported scores, rankings, ablation outcomes and embedding findings are identical. For example, Table 6 retains Yamanishi 08 warm-start AUROC of 0.9771 ± 0.0042; no result entries are added or removed.

T1.justification: The Gramian-volume definition, contrastive objectives, gradient-selection formulas, IC50 discretization and appendix equations are unchanged. No mathematical assumptions, derivations or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction contributions and conclusion retain the same claims about four-modality alignment, adaptive dropout, IC50 supervision and performance across four benchmarks.

C2.justification: Component interpretations and generalization arguments are identical. Section 5 retains the limitations concerning complete quadruplets and overlap removal restricting pretraining diversity, together with the proposed expansion of protein modalities.

D1.justification: Appendices B, C, E and F retain identical data-processing instructions, encoder/projector specifications, hyperparameters, hardware descriptions and retrieval/visualization settings. Code and data access information is unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2, the reference list and research-positioning statements are identical, including the claimed novelty of adaptive modality dropout for DTI prediction.

P1.justification: v2 expands the affiliation from University of Texas to University of Texas at Arlington and updates the arXiv version/date stamp. PDF title metadata corrects GRAM-TDI to GRAM-DTI; the printed title, scientific prose and document organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1–8, Tables 1–6, captions and their placement are unchanged. The first-page affiliation edit retains the existing layout; all subsequent pages render identically.

improvement.justification: v2 makes the affiliation more precise and corrects PDF title metadata, but leaves the scientific content, empirical evidence, reproducibility information and appendices unchanged. These administrative refinements do not meaningfully alter the paper's overall quality.
